review: Automated regression, visual capture review, and adversarial implementation review passed.

findings.finding: Wheel dust originally remained at the hidden physical collider instead of the visible travelling support.
findings.resolution: The dust raycast now originates at the visible support position.

findings.finding: An authored road bump could originally overlap a wind balance window.
findings.resolution: Bump contact waits until the current wind balance window is over.

findings.finding: The initial route-coordinate trigger could fire before the bump reached the wheel on screen.
findings.resolution: Contact now compares the bump and visible wheel in world space and has a regression test.

residual_risk: The support model preserves the proven physical wheel collider while moving the visible support and applying bounded transient torque; only an iPhone feel test can validate the illusion.
Moving badges and road bumps improve route variation, but replay interest remains an owner judgment rather than an automated fact.
next_gate: Install and launch the exact committed revision on iPhone, then collect the owner feel verdict.
